-:NOTICE:-
No.RjJ/ 14/2024
In view of the decision of the Hon'ble Standing
Committee dated 13.03.2024 and as per the direction
of the Hon'ble the Chief Justice, all the learned
Advocates / Litigants / Stakeholders are hereby
intimated that the cases listed in the warned list of all
Courts (except the cases of Courts No.8, 17 and 19),
will be taken up in seriatim by the concerned Courts, in
the second session of every Wednesday, as the post
lunch session of every Wednesday is dedicated for
critically old cases. It is further informed that the cases
in the warned list when listed in the Court will not be
adjourned and no sick note or leave note will be
entertained. It is further informed that the matter listed
in the warned list, will be listed on every Wednesday
irrespective of the fact that the said matters are fixed
or adjourned to any other dates. It is further informed
that out of 50 oldest cases listed in the warned fist of
each Court (except the Courts Nos.8, 17 and 19), the
cause-list of 10 cases of each Court will be prepared as
per the age of the cases for every Wednesday, from
24.04.2024 onwards, irrespective of the fact that the
said cases are adjourned to any other date or the said
Cases are undated and the said cases will be taken up
in the post lunch session of every Wednesday. It is
further informed
